Cameras in New York City, USA, documented an assault by an occupation supporter, who spat directly at anti-Zionist Orthodox rabbis during a protest condemning the crimes and brutality of the occupation.
The protest, organized by the Jewish “Neturei Karta” movement, raised banners stating that “Labeling people as anti-Semites cannot justify occupation and brutality,” which angered occupation supporters, leading one of them to commit this hostile act amid widespread condemnation from bystanders.

الوقفة التي نظمتها حركة "ناطوري كارتا" اليهودية رفعت لافتات تؤكد أن "وصم الناس بمعاداة السامية لا يمكنه تبرير الاحتلال والوحشية"، وهو ما أثار غضب المؤيدين للاحتلال، ليدفع أحدهم بممارسة هذا السلوك العدائي وسط استنكار واسع من المارّة.

If you missed what happened yesterday.. we would like to remind you that these scenes document how the people of the Gaza Strip spent the first nights of Eid.

The occupation forces are evacuating residents from the besieged building and demanding that a young man surrender himself, west of Nablus city.
